=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- `scripts/unblock_judge.sh`: lines 289-298 (telegram operation case) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The CRITICAL alert message says "label write failed" when the condition `ops_failed=true && close_succeeded != true` is met, but this condition catches two distinct failure modes: (1) close succeeded but label write failed, and (2) close itself failed.
  WHY: An operator receiving the alert "Unblock judge could not mark project #N for closure; label write failed" would investigate label permissions and API scope, when the actual failure was that the close operation itself failed (e.g., network error, permissions issue on the close endpoint). The `close_failed` variable is available in scope and should be checked to distinguish the two cases. The LAST RUN DIFF introduced this misleading message; before, the code silently continued without any alert.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
